description: Search, organize, export, and audit your Cosmos inspiration library from the terminal.

novel_features.name: Weekly library review
novel_features.description: Turn recent saves, unfiled elements, duplicate connections, AI flags, and missing attribution into a deterministic maintenance queue.

novel_features.name: Collection overlap
novel_features.description: Compare two collections and report shared elements, duplicate media, and references unique to each side.

novel_features.name: Search coverage gap
novel_features.description: Compare live Cosmos search results with live collection membership and return promising references that are not already saved.

novel_features.name: Provenance audit
novel_features.description: Report missing source URLs or authors and show source concentration from live collection elements.

novel_features.name: Similarity trail
novel_features.description: Walk visual similarity results to a bounded depth and emit a deduplicated, source-aware graph.

novel_features.name: Snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Compare historical collection membership and show added, removed, and moved elements.
